dos.text: Use popupnotificationcontent for extra body content, appendNotificationContent() is real and repeatable, so more than one is fine.
Set dropmarkerhidden when you want a plain secondary button, the secondary button defaults to a split-type chevron/menu affordance otherwise.

donts.text: Don't rely on native <slot> projection for popupnotificationheader/popupnotificationcontent/popupnotificationfooter children, they're matched by tag name via querySelector, not real slot assignment, so an unrelated element sharing one of those tag names would also get picked up.

Don't assume buttoncommand/secondarybuttoncommand automatically do something, both are cancelable CustomEvents only forwarded to PopupNotifications._onButtonEvent if a listener doesn't cancel them first.
